cards.title: Human Simulation Input Definitions and Scenario Constraints
cards.claim: Prospective human IV PK curve simulations require explicit definitions of the regimen (dose, basis, bolus/infusion, interval), concentration basis (total/free), and time horizon. Inputs must distinguish existing data from predicted parameters. Vss must not be silently treated as Vc; multi-compartment profiles require distribution parameters beyond total CL and Vss.
conditions: Applies when the project requests a prospective human IV profile.
Prospective predictions use qualified predicted parameters with stated applicability and assumptions.
required_inputs: Qualified predicted parameters from translation branch.
limitations: A unique multi-compartment curve cannot be derived from CL and Vss alone.
Measured human variability or clinical validation is not established by this process.
cards.downstream_use: Defines the boundary conditions for simulation execution and identifies missing scientific scenario definitions.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
